events.text: Built the untouched-legacy side-by-side replacement under framework/world_loader: 23 focused Zig modules plus a narrow framework/world_loader.zig facade. Public loader and Runtime APIs match exactly; fixture semantic parity and active 36MB editor-gamefile construction/capture comparisons are green. Final scoped commits are next.

resolution: Rebuilt the compiled world loader alongside the untouched legacy comparator as a narrow public facade plus 23 focused Zig modules covering configuration, state, construction, geometry, physics, presentation, streaming, live editor ingress, paint, transport, foliage, simulation, and interaction. The legacy source remains byte-identical at SHA-256 dd65fb8d..., both the top-level and Runtime public declaration sets match exactly, fixture construction parity was exact, and both implementations produced identical construction facts for the active 36 MB editor gamefile. Added a same-layer geometry fingerprint target and documentation for boundaries and side-by-side builds. All targeted dependency suites passed except the already-red game-physics hollow-ramp assertion (46/47), reproduced twice without any physics-file modification.
